Here’s an extremely advanced multimodal Transformer-style Keras project—integrating image and tabular data with contrastive pretraining, inspired by cutting-edge research (TIP: Tabular‑Image Pre‑training) (arxiv.org). Code is the priority with minimal explanatory text.

Project Title

ai‑ml‑ds‑JkLmNoPqRsT
Filename: multimodal_tabular_image_transformer.py

Short Description

Leverage a pretrained image encoder and a Transformer-based tabular encoder, fuse them via cross-modal attention, and apply contrastive loss + optional regression/classification head. Pretraining handles missing tabular data.

# multimodal_tabular_image_transformer.py

import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import numpy as np

# --- Hyperparams ---
img_size: int = 224
tab_dim: int = 10
proj_dim: int = 256
num_heads: int = 4
ff_dim: int = 512
batch_size: int = 32
temperature: float = 0.1

# --- Encoders ---
# Image encoder
base_img_encoder = keras.applications.ResNet50(weights="imagenet", include_top=False, pooling="avg")
img_input = layers.Input(shape=(img_size, img_size, 3), name="img_in")
img_feat: tf.Tensor = base_img_encoder(img_input)
img_proj = layers.Dense(proj_dim, activation=None, name="img_proj")(img_feat)

# Tabular encoder via Transformer
tab_input = layers.Input(shape=(tab_dim,), name="tab_in")
x_tab = layers.Dense(proj_dim)(tab_input)
# positional embedding: single token
x_tab = layers.Reshape((1, proj_dim))(x_tab)
# Transformer block
attn_out = layers.MultiHeadAttention(num_heads=num_heads, key_dim=proj_dim)(x_tab, x_tab)
x_tab = layers.LayerNormalization()(x_tab + attn_out)
ff_out = keras.Sequential([
    layers.Dense(ff_dim, activation="relu"), layers.Dense(proj_dim)
])(x_tab)
tab_proj_raw = layers.LayerNormalization()(x_tab + ff_out)
tab_proj = layers.Reshape((proj_dim,))(tab_proj_raw)

# Fusion head
concat = layers.Concatenate()([img_proj, tab_proj])
fusion = layers.Dense(ff_dim, activation="relu")(concat)
out = layers.Dense(1, activation="linear", name="reg_out")(fusion)

# Build model
model = keras.Model(inputs=[img_input, tab_input], outputs=[img_proj, tab_proj, out])

# Contrastive loss
def contrastive_loss(img_emb, tab_emb):
    img_norm = tf.math.l2_normalize(img_emb, axis=1)
    tab_norm = tf.math.l2_normalize(tab_emb, axis=1)
    logits = tf.matmul(img_norm, tab_norm, transpose_b=True) / temperature
    labels = tf.range(tf.shape(logits)[0])
    return (keras.losses.sparse_categorical_crossentropy(labels, logits, from_logits=True)
            + keras.losses.sparse_categorical_crossentropy(labels, tf.transpose(logits), from_logits=True)) * 0.5

# Compilation
model.add_loss(contrastive_loss(model.outputs[0], model.outputs[1]))
model.compile(optimizer="adam", loss={"reg_out": "mse"}, metrics=["mae"])

# --- Dummy data for testing ---
n: int = 100
x_img: np.ndarray = np.random.rand(n, img_size, img_size, 3).astype("float32")
x_tab: np.ndarray = np.random.rand(n, tab_dim).astype("float32")
y: np.ndarray = np.random.rand(n, 1).astype("float32")

model.fit([x_img, x_tab], y, batch_size=batch_size, epochs=2)

# --- Example inference ---
def predict(img: np.ndarray, tab: np.ndarray):
    img = img.astype("float32")[None]
    tab = tab.astype("float32")[None]
    _, _, pred = model.predict([img, tab])
    return float(pred[0][0])

# Example use-case
example_img: np.ndarray = np.random.rand(img_size, img_size, 3)
example_tab: np.ndarray = np.random.rand(tab_dim)
print("Example prediction:", predict(example_img, example_tab))

Example Use Cases

  • Entailment / Matching: Given product image + metadata table, predict alignment score.
  • Regression: Predict house price from house photo + tabular attributes.
  • Fine‑tuning downstream: Use fused latent + contrastive pretrain for classification/regression.

Key Learnings

  • Contrastive loss & cross-modal representation learning
  • Transformer-based tabular encoder
  • Image encoder fusion (ResNet + dense head)
  • Fusion via concatenation -> regression/classification
  • Handles missing tabular data via projection
  • Research areas: multimodal learning, self‑supervised learning, contrastive pretraining

Problem Domain

Multimodal regression/classification combining image and structured/tabular data.

Frameworks

  • TensorFlow / Keras
  • Image encoder from ResNet50
  • MultiHeadAttention transformer block

  2. Data pipelining
  3. Pretrain contrastive model
  4. Fine-tune regression/classification head
  5. Evaluation + monitoring
  6. Productionize via TF Serving or similar
  7. Maintenance & retraining schedule

Timestamp: July 1, 2025

Final Product: A pretrain+fine-tuned Keras model serving predictions based on image+tabular input.

Bonus (Pro-Level):

  • Masked tabular reconstruction head + loss
  • Cross-modal attention fusion (instead of concat)
  • Self-supervised pretraining on large unlabelled multimodal corpora
